Build skills. Make discoveries.

High School
Discover. Specialize. Create.

Explore engineering interests through CAD design and a concise look at university-level engineering paths. The intended pathway builds toward documented, independent project work.

The growth to look for.

Engineering judgement, design decisions and a record of iteration. No university credit or admission outcome is promised.

Grade is a guide, not a placement test.

Share interests and prior experience. The right starting point depends on what the learner can already do and explain.

Grades 7–9 · High School

World Robot Olympiad

Future pathway · Register interest

Prepare for the World Robot Olympiad across three category formats—mission-based robots, a self-driving vehicle challenge and real-world research projects—each with its own age division, team size and judging focus.

Explore this program →

High School

Distilled Series

Future pathway · Register interest

A concise, project-based look at computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering—for a high schooler weighing university majors, not exam prep.

Explore this program →

Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

3D Design & Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Start with shapes and dimensions, then explore fit, function and iteration. Printing becomes one step in a thoughtful design process.

Explore this program →

Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

DTF Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Learn how direct-to-film (DTF) printing turns a digital design into a durable, full-colour transfer that can be pressed onto fabric. Understand the process from file prep to finished press.

Explore this program →

Grades 7–9 · High School · Adult

UV Printing

Future pathway · Register interest

Learn how UV printers apply ink directly onto rigid or flexible surfaces—like acrylic, wood or metal—and cure it instantly with UV light. Explore how material, ink layers and finish affect the result.

Explore this program →

High School · Adult

IELTS Preparation

Future pathway · Register interest

Work through the Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking sections of the IELTS exam, with practice tasks and feedback aimed at a clear target band score.

Explore this program →
